local function phase1()
local output=print
local function print(...) output("West course phase 1:",...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local before=nil
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 local inv=Actor.inventory(self)
 local sorcery=core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x931a)
 local respite=core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x930e)
 local magicka=Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self)
 local mp=magicka.current
 if not before then before=mp assert(inv:countOf(sorcery)==1 and inv:countOf(respite)==1,'Remaining supplies missing') print('Substructure healing ready') end
 if inv:countOf(sorcery)==0 and inv:countOf(respite)==0 and mp>=math.min(before+40,magicka.base+magicka.modifier)-.01 then print('Remaining supplies consumed and magicka restored') end
end}}}}

end
local function phase2()
local output=print
local function print(...) output("West course phase 2:",...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local frame=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frame=frame+1
 local hp=Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 local mp=Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self) and hp>0,'Player died during ordinary recovery')
 if frame==5 then print('Full recovery ready') end
 if mp>=19 then print('Recovery magicka ready') end
 if hp>=79.99 then print('Recovery health full') end
 if mp>=79.99 then print('Recovery magicka full') end
 if frame%30==0 then print('Recovery health='..hp..' magicka='..mp) end
end}}}}

end
local input=require('openmw.input')
local phases={{phase1,phase2}}
local n=1
local active=phases[n]()
local held=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F8)
 if down and not held then n=n+1 assert(phases[n],'Unexpected west observation phase') active=phases[n]() print('West observation phase '..n..' ready') end
 held=down
 active.engineHandlers.onFrame(dt)
end}}}}
